WITH account_orders AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM account_orders
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.account_id,
    ao.order_count,
    ao.order_count - oa.avg_count as above_overall_avg
  FROM account_orders ao
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ao.order_count > oa.avg_count
),
above_avg_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT 
  aa.account_id,
  aa.order_count,
  aa.above_overall_avg,
  aa.order_count - aaa.avg_count as above_above_avg
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_average aaa
ORDER BY above_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
